stability.p25_p50_p75_p90_p99 = nearest-rank percentiles of keygen/sign cycles
stability.StQ1_StQ2_StQ3 = stabilized quartiles: [1/8,3/8], [3/8,5/8], [5/8,7/8] means; see Daniel J. Bernstein, Robust statistics for rejection-sampling timings, https://cr.yp.to/papers/rsrst-20250727.pdf
stability.stddev = population standard deviation of keygen/sign cycles; lower means less run-to-run spread
stability.cv = stddev/avg; rough guide: <1% very stable, 1-5% stable, 5-15% noisy, >15% unstable or long-tailed
stability.outlier_count = number of keygen/sign runs slower than 1.5x p50
stability.p90_p50 = p90/p50 tail-inflation ratio; values near 1.00x mean a short tail
stability.p99_p50 = p99/p50 tail-inflation ratio; values near 1.00x mean a short tail
